title: pleuranthodium tephrochlamys
intro: Pleuranthodium tephrochlamys, commonly known as Mountain Ginger, is a plant species that belongs to the family Zingiberaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine in the Philippines to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Pleuranthodium tephrochlamys include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in reducing pain, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gingerols and shogaols, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
